title: Kasha's Bet That Rwandan Women Would Order Private Products by Phone
conflicts: Series A size: Disrupt Africa / Africa.com (Nov 2020) say US$3 million, TechCrunch (2023) says $3.6 million (consistent with The Condia's $26.1m total); not used in the story. Launch: July 2016 (Disrupt Africa) vs a tenth anniversary on 5 June 2026 (New Times); story says mid-2016. Outcome totals are all company figures at different dates (100,000th order by end-2018; 70,000 customers and 700,000 units in 2020; 110 million products in March 2026 vs 140 million in June 2026); story uses only the dated 100,000th-order milestone.
notes: The three-month 'will they buy, will they come back' test rests on Bichsel's own TechCabal interview and is attributed to her. A 2016 GeekWire launch article and the New Times 2019 interview were not usable (blocked / body not served). Quote stance affirms; the connection notes that choosing a trouble is not the same as the choice being easy. Reflection is about chosen and unchosen burdens, not laboratories.
